# maltysnack.github.io

[maltysnack.github.io](https://maltysnack.github.io). Personal site, plain HTML, no framework.

### Projects

**FPL bot:**<br>
An autonomous Fantasy Premier League bot: how it is doing, where the points went, and whether its model can be trusted.

**World Cup 2026:**<br>
A paper-money betting bot that bets Elo model chances against Sportsbet 1X2 prices, plus the scored 2026 World Cup forecast.

**Flox:**<br>
A small language for flow networks: write nodes and arrows, and it simulates how something moves through them.

**Algorithms:**<br>
Search and optimisation algorithms running live: pathfinding, a sliding-tile puzzle and a travelling salesman tour.

**Flock:**<br>
A flock in three dimensions from three local rules and no leader, with a hawk to run from.

### Games

**dnd:**<br>
D&D 5e character sheets that save in your browser: track HP, slots, spells and loot.

**Duoclue:**<br>
Describe the word using exactly two words. A party game for one phone.
